chunks: "The one prevented and the one compelled slaughter their sacrificial camels in the place where they are compelled."

key_terms.الْمَحْصُورُ: the one prevented or constrained from completing the rite
key_terms.الْمَكَانِ: the location where the ruling is to be carried out
key_terms.بَدَنَتَيْهِمَا: their two sacrificial camels or camel-offerings
key_terms.يَنْحَرَانِ: they slaughter by nahr, specifically sacrificial camels

ai.seo_question: Where should the prevented or compelled pilgrim slaughter the sacrificial camel?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning those unable to proceed normally in hajj or related sacrificial rites due to prevention or necessity. It states that such individuals are to slaughter their sacrificial camels at the very place where they are forced to stop.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3105 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The Mahsur (prevented) and the Mudtarr (compelled) should slaughter their sacrificial camels in the place where they are compelled to stop."
